comment: The nine knobs are the weights at the nine points that divide the range into eight intervals (randomwrangler.cpp:139-145), not weights of nine intervals as docs/rw.md has it; in linear mode the chance slopes from one knob's weight to the next, and in constant mode the eight intervals take the first eight weights and the ninth is unused. The internal clock is a plain oscillator based at C4 (barebone.cpp:29), so the RATE knob's range of -10 to +10 is in octaves from 261.63Hz rather than a rate in Hz.
